project: Preliminary Handbook of the Mark VIII Tank
page_mapping: For page n >= 2: scan=floor(n/2)+1; even=left, odd=right. Title=scan001 right. Leading blank excluded.
font: Bundled C059 OpenType, provisional Century approximation
art_geometry: No rotation or nonlinear dewarp applied
editable_text: Individual source lines; tables use separate cells
pdf_naming_policy: Use unique page-range and version suffix for every released PDF, including revisions; never deliver an unversioned Handbook_Master.pdf.
previous_pdf_preservation: Pages 1–240 pixel-identical to v12 at 144 dpi; all 17,216 earlier page objects retain content, geometry and style assignments. All earlier named styles unchanged; only internal object IDs regenerated.
ocr_crop_policy_batch08: Draft OCR used left-page crop x=0..1850 and bottom y=2505 to retain gutter-side text. New-page comparison crops remain nominal left x=0..1750; original text fits within that range.
ocr_crop_policy_batch09: Draft OCR used left-page crop x=0..1850 and bottom y=2505 to retain gutter-side content. This batch source comparison uses nominal page halves; original text and artwork fit within these.
ocr_crop_policy_batch10: Draft OCR used left-page crop x=0..1850 and bottom y=2505. New source comparisons use nominal halves. Part/quantity columns were transcribed separately and source-checked.
plate_numbering_note: Page 212 has two unnumbered speed/governor charts between printed Plates 125 and 127. No Plate 126 label is added.
ocr_crop_policy_batch11: Nominal source halves for comparison. Draft OCR uses wider left halves to protect gutter content; explicit part/quantity transcription and shared-description geometry.
ocr_crop_policy_batch12: Draft OCR uses wider left halves; comparison uses nominal halves. Explicit part/quantity transcription. Page 240 index is transcribed directly from the scan; no top folio is invented.
completion: All available scanned content reconstructed through printed page 251; independent proofreading and typography/trim review pending.
ocr_crop_policy_batch13: Final index transcribed from full source halves. Draft OCR starts at x=100 and clips leading letters on some right pages; it is retained only as a draft. References received a separate column OCR check and direct scan review. Comparisons use nominal halves.
